reviews.text:
Excellent service, a wide variety of products of all kinds.
And a very good hairdressing service.
They're wonderful, and it smells amazing when you walk in; the cleanliness is a delight. A 10 out of 10!
Very professional in their treatment of pets ☺️!! Good service and flexibility
WOW Miriam (grooming) is the best!! I haven't found anyone like her who cares with such love and attention. Simply my new go-to place for my dogs :) 100% recommended

The Google schedule isn't accurate. I went there twice, and they denied being closed. Once without explanation, and the second time, they posted a sign saying they were closed as of August 10th. But the map said the store was open at that time.
The store itself is nice, but I have to walk quite a distance to get there, and if I'd known it was closed, I would have chosen another store in the chain.

I take Lola to the doggy daycare and we're delighted. She plays and socializes with other dogs in a safe environment. Miriam is very affectionate with them. Marina solved a huge problem with Lola, who kept escaping from her harness and was difficult to walk. She fixed it with a chest harness.
The best!
Excellent treatment and great professionalism from the ethologist Marina and her colleagues
I always find everything I need for my dog, and Marina, the owner, always has the best advice! A 10 out of 10!
I've always thought that you need a special gift to work with animals. You certainly have that gift. A wonderful team!
We've been taking our dog there since the grooming salon opened. Very friendly service, great professionals. Our dog loves going.
We were very happy with the service. Marina is very attentive and always gives us the best advice. 100% recommended.
Excellent service and lots of experience
Excellent and friendly service, I will definitely return. Highly recommended.
I'm extremely careful when trimming my dog's nails. I'm very patient with her because she has a hard time doing it.
We always bring Otto to Interzoo for his monthly wash. He leaves delighted and with very clean fur.
Very friendly and the food was of very good quality, highly recommended.
We were delighted with the service and how caring they were. Gala looked absolutely gorgeous! 😍 …
Thank you so much Ramón, it's a pleasure to have Dana as a client 😍🥰 …

They're fantastic. They give great advice and know a ton.
They care about my dog ​​and know him well.
And they also offer grooming services.

Incredible experience; the professionalism and service of the staff are exceptional.
Highly recommended.
A really great store!!! They're fantastic!!

My go-to shop for everything for my four-legged companions. Thank you to Marina for being so wonderful, you radiate light, and thank you to your team for being so kind and attentive. And I'm so grateful for the home delivery!
Big hugs!
Marina and her shop are as great as always…good service and good food for my pets
I went there without being very clear about what the best food for Ulthar might be, and Miriam took great care of me and answered all my questions about it.
Miriam provided excellent service and advice! Good prices.
It's our go-to store; the service is friendly and welcoming. 100% recommended.
Thank you!!!! 😊 …

Excellent experience! This pet shop and grooming salon truly stands out for its professionalism and friendliness. From the very first moment, the staff was very attentive and knowledgeable, explaining in detail how my Toy Poodle puppy's first haircut would be done, which gave me a lot of confidence. It's clear they know what they're doing and genuinely care about the well-being of pets.

In addition, the shop has a very large and well-stocked section of dog food, treats, toys, and all kinds of accessories. It's an ideal place to find everything your pet needs in one place. I will definitely return and highly recommend it to other dog owners.
Excellent service
Vito looks so clean after his grooming appointment, and you cut his nails with such care! Marina is a true professional, thank you for everything!
Chester is very happy with your service, we love the hair salon and they have great food brands, 100% recommended!!!!
They have a real gift with animals. My dog ​​turns into a little gremlin when you touch his nails, and they trimmed them here without any problem. Amazing service. Highly recommended.
The best place to take your furry friends! Very professional in everything!
We take our dog to the doggy daycare and he loves it!! They're great girls and Marina is a true professional!!!
I'm so happy with the service...the care and attention they give Otto is unbeatable. 100% recommended.
They are always very professional and friendly. Thank you.
Marina always has solutions and services that meet the needs of our dog, Luke, who is always happy when he arrives at the Interzoo gate!!! Highly, highly, highly recommended.
Great service, very good professionals, I've been with them for a while and I'm delighted, my dog ​​is too.
Thank you so much!!

Horrible service. This morning I had an appointment that I couldn't make, and they kindly rescheduled it for 3:00 PM. I arrived at 2:55 PM, and since I didn't know if they were in because the website says they open at 5:00 PM, I called them. I called to ask if they were in, but they didn't answer. They called me back 5 minutes later, asking what was wrong with me, saying that she had lunch from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM. She was very rude, and I told her that I didn't need to know her schedule. She repeated rudely that it was her lunch break. I don't think the woman who answered was the manager; she was very unpleasant. I didn't even dare leave my dog ​​with her.
I won't be back.

Marina and her team are by far the best in Valencia. Professionalism and care for the animals.
Highly professional.
My pleasure, Silvia 😘❤️ …
Very good. Bath, brushing, haircut, and attention. My poodle, Pines, came out looking beautiful and happy.

Upon our arrival, the saleswoman rushed at us, speaking very quickly. Being French, we explained that we didn't understand, and she informed us that she was unable to help us. Perhaps they should consider welcoming customers more warmly, regardless of their nationality...
